mapper.select: select a.*,b.NAME as userName,c.INDEX as professionIndex,c.NAME as professionName from BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM_USER a left join BIZ_CAD_USER b on a.CAD_USER_ID = b.ID left join BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION c on a.CAD_PROFESSION_ID = c.ID where a.SUB_ITEM_ID = #{subItemId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' order by c.INDEX
